[[File:Toyo Mitsunobu and his family.jpg|thumb|Family photograph, {{circa}} 1940–1944]]
{{Nihongo|'''Ōyō Mitsunobu'''|光延 旺洋|Mitsunobu Ōyō|1934–2003}} was a Japanese chemist specializing in organic synthesis. In 1967, he introduced the [[Mitsunobu reaction]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Mitsunobu |first=Oyo |last2=Yamada |first2=Masaaki |date=1967-10-01 |title=Preparation of Esters of Carboxylic and Phosphoric Acid via Quaternary Phosphonium Salts |url=https://doi.org/10.1246/bcsj.40.2380 |journal=[[Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan]] |volume=40 |issue=10 |pages=2380–2382 |doi=10.1246/bcsj.40.2380 |issn=0009-2673|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Mitsunobu |first=Oyo |date=1981 |title=The Use of Diethyl Azodicarboxylate and Triphenylphosphine in Synthesis and Transformation of Natural Products |url=http://www.thieme-connect.de/DOI/DOI?10.1055/s-1981-29317 |journal=[[Synthesis (journal)|Synthesis]] |language=en |volume=1981 |issue=01 |pages=1–28 |doi=10.1055/s-1981-29317 |issn=0039-7881|url-access=subscription }}</ref> which is named after him.

His father was [[Tōyō Mitsunobu]], an admiral (posthumously) of the Japanese navy.<ref>{{cite book |title=現代物故者事典2003〜2005 |publisher=日外アソシエーツ {{ill|Nichigai Associates|ja|日外アソシエーツ}} |location=Tokyo |year=2006 |page=580 |language=ja |trans-title=Contemporary Obituary Dictionary 2003–2005|isbn=978-4-8169-1969-5}}</ref> Mitsunobu earned his bachelor's degree at [[Gakushuin University]] in Tokyo and subsequently studied at the [[Tokyo Institute of Technology]] starting in 1959, where he obtained his doctorate in 1966 under the supervision of [[Teruaki Mukaiyama]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Murakami |first=Masahiro |date=2021 |title=Achievements of the Late Professor Teruaki Mukaiyama |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/tcr.202000105 |journal={{ill|The Chemical Record|qid=Q3520251|s=1}} |language=en |volume=21 |issue=1 |pages=2–16 |doi=10.1002/tcr.202000105 |issn=1528-0691|url-access=subscription }}</ref> From 1986-2002 he was a Professor in the Faculty of Science and Engineering, [[Aoyama Gakuin University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=光延 旺洋 |url=https://nrid.nii.ac.jp/nrid/1000090082792/ |access-date=2026-08-11 |website=KAKEN}}</ref> 

His work focused on the chemistry of [[nucleosides]] and [[nucleotides]], as well as [[stereoselective]] reactions. He is best known for the Mitsunobu reaction which involves the substitution of (primary or secondary) alcohols with [[nucleophiles]] (the original reaction was an [[esterification]]) and has found widespread application, particularly in the synthesis of [[natural product]]s and in [[biochemistry]]. It proceeds under relatively mild conditions and is [[stereospecific]]. It is an oxidation-reduction [[condensation reaction]] in which [[triphenylphosphine]] is oxidized and [[diethyl azodicarboxylate]] (DEAD) is reduced to its corresponding [[hydrazine]] derivative (reagents serving a similar function to triphenylphosphine and DEAD in the original version of the reaction are known as Mitsunobu reagents). Mitsunobu introduced the reaction in 1967 and developed several variants shortly thereafter. Between 1996 and 2008, 1,615 papers with "Mitsunobu reaction" in the title were published according to [[SciFinder]], including 186 patents.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Swamy |first1=K. C. Kumara |last2=Kumar |first2=N. N. Bhuvan |last3=Balaraman |first3=E. |last4=Kumar |first4=K. V. P. Pavan |title=Mitsunobu and Related Reactions: Advances and Applications |journal=[[Chemical Reviews]] |date=10 June 2009 |volume=109 |issue=6 |pages=2551–2651 |doi=10.1021/cr800278z}}</ref>

In 1984 he received the Synthetic Organic Chemistry Award, Japan. The text of the award states that it is for the "Discovery and development of stereospecific reactions through activation of alcoholic hydroxyl groups".<ref>{{Cite web |title=有機合成化学協会賞 |trans-title=Society of Synthetic Organic Chemistry Award |url=https://www.ssocj.jp/award/association/ |access-date=2026-08-11 |work={{ill|Society of Synthetic Organic Chemistry, Japan|ja|有機合成化学協会}} |language=ja |quote=アルコール性水酸基の活性化による立体特異的反応の発見とその展開 |trans-quote=Discovery and development of stereospecific reactions through activation of alcoholic hydroxyl groups}}</ref>
